comparison.objective: Load and center a wafer on a spin-coater chuck using tweezers and an aligner while controlling the lid.
comparison.physical_skill: Tool-mediated edge handling, tool change, submillimetre centering, lid stabilization, and aligner withdrawal.
comparison.success_condition: Wafer centered within 0.5 mm on the 24 mm chuck, lid closed, with no gripper or fingertip contact on the wafer top.
comparison.reason: Shares demanding bimanual tool alignment and careful withdrawal, but tests contamination-safe placement of an intact wafer, not controlled impact fracture and collection of four released fragments.
